method: All 121 paragraphs on pages 27–33 read individually. Source allegations are preserved as attributed claims; no source time is converted into an audio clip timestamp.
phrases: side note
a brief additional comment outside the main story
补充说明；题外话
A quick side note: the entrance is at the back.
补充说明一下：入口在后面。
Signals a digression explaining roles rather than a new event in the timeline.
house mom
an informal name for a residential house director
会所宿舍主管（非正式称呼）
The students spoke to the house mom about repairs.
学生们向宿舍主管反映了维修问题。
Not a biological mother or student big sister; role explained in adjacent paragraphs.
heads out
leaves or starts going somewhere
出发；离开
She heads out at eight each morning.
她每天早上八点出门。
Head is a movement verb here, not a body part.
let Jane in
allowed Jane to enter; let someone in is the reusable form
让简进来；允许某人进入
Please let the visitors in.
请让访客们进来。
Person-specific source phrase retained; teaching model generalizes the object without presenting it as original dialogue.
having a good time
enjoying oneself
玩得开心
The children were having a good time at the picnic.
孩子们在野餐时玩得很开心。
General narrator description of the party; not evidence of any individual's later consent.
so-called friend
someone described as a friend whose behavior calls that description into question
所谓的朋友
His so-called friend never returned the borrowed money.
他那个所谓的朋友一直没还借走的钱。
So-called expresses distance or criticism, not a neutral synonym for named.
in the sense that
in the particular respect explained by the following clause
从……这个意义上说
The room is public in the sense that anyone on the team can use it.
从团队里任何人都能使用的意义上说，这个房间是公用的。
Limits what social room means: the speaker explains unlocked access, not ownership.
take a nap
sleep for a short time
小睡一会儿
I might take a nap after lunch.
午饭后我可能会小睡一会儿。
Source reports the statement; new example is ordinary daily life.
pushing his hand away
moving his hand away from oneself; push something away is the transferable pattern
把他的手推开
She kept pushing the loose cable away from her chair.
她不断把松垂的电缆从椅子旁推开。
Source describes resistance; do not recast it as consent or ordinary mutual play.
group chat
a shared messaging conversation with several participants
群聊
We use a group chat to arrange meetings.
我们用群聊安排会议。
Membership does not prove each person read or acted on a message.
pull up
arrive or come over, in informal slang
过来；到场（口语）
You can pull up around eight if you're free.
如果有空，你可以八点左右过来。
PU is interpreted by the narrator as pull up but immediately qualified in 543. Do not turn that expansion into a verified message transcription.
